parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const props = { email: $json.email, lead_score: String($json.lead_score), hs_lead_status: $json.lead_score >= 80 ? 'IN_PROGRESS' : 'NEW', xnoria_tags: $json.tags.join(',') }; if ($json.company) props.company = $json.company; if ($json.phone) props.phone = $json.phone; if ($json.industry) props.industry = $json.industry; return JSON.stringify({ inputs: [{ idProperty: 'email', id: $json.email, properties: props }] }); })() }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: $('Code -- extract contact_id').item.json.hubspot_error ? 'error' : 'executed', action_id: 'acq.lead.score', contact_id: $('Code -- extract contact_id').item.json.contact_id, email: $('Code -- extract contact_id').item.json.email, lead_score: $('Code -- extract contact_id').item.json.lead_score, tags: $('Code -- extract contact_id').item.json.tags, hubspot_error: $('Code -- extract contact_id').item.json.hubspot_error }) }}
